name: responsive-design
description: Build and audit responsive interfaces across mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop. Use whenever creating or modifying frontend layouts.

# Responsive Design

Design mobile and desktop experiences intentionally.

Check:

- mobile
- tablet
- laptop
- large desktop

Do NOT simply shrink the desktop layout.

Consider:

- navigation
- typography
- spacing
- grids
- cards
- forms
- tables
- images
- buttons
- touch targets
- overflow
- content priority

On smaller screens:

- simplify navigation
- prioritize important content
- stack elements when appropriate
- prevent horizontal overflow
- maintain readable typography
- maintain comfortable touch targets

Use the existing project's responsive conventions and framework.

Before finishing, verify that the UI works at multiple viewport sizes.
